title: 回文字符串的最大数量
summary: 可任意交换所有单词任意位置的字符，但每个单词长度不变；求最终能成为回文串的单词最大数量。
insight: 全局字符可自由重排，形成长度 L 的回文只消耗 floor(L/2) 对相同字符，奇数中心可由剩余单字符填充。统计所有字符对数，并按单词长度升序优先满足所需字符对最少的单词，即可最大化数量。
pitfalls: 字符可跨不同单词交换
偶数长度全部位置成对，奇数长度少一个中心
可用字符对数是各字符频次除二之和

solutions.title: 排序长度并消耗字符对
solutions.idea: 把字符资源压缩为可用相同字符对的总数后贪心分配。
steps: 统计所有 words 中二十六个字符的总频次
提取并升序排序每个单词长度

code.java: class Solution { public int maxPalindromesAfterOperations(String[] words){int[] frequency=new int[26],lengths=new int[words.length];for(int index=0;index<words.length;index++){lengths[index]=words[index].length();for(char letter:words[index].toCharArray())frequency[letter-'a']++;}int pairs=0;for(int count:frequency)pairs+=count/2;Arrays.sort(lengths);int answer=0;for(int length:lengths){int need=length/2;if(pairs<need)break;pairs-=need;answer++;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxPalindromesAfterOperations(words:Array<String>):Int{val frequency=IntArray(26);val lengths=IntArray(words.size);for(index in words.indices){lengths[index]=words[index].length;for(letter in words[index])frequency[letter-'a']++};var pairs=frequency.sumOf{it/2};lengths.sort();var answer=0;for(length in lengths){val need=length/2;if(pairs<need)break;pairs-=need;answer++};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maxPalindromesAfterOperations(vector<string>& words){int frequency[26]={},pairs=0,answer=0;vector<int> lengths;for(auto& word:words){lengths.push_back(word.size());for(char letter:word)++frequency[letter-'a'];}for(int count:frequency)pairs+=count/2;sort(lengths.begin(),lengths.end());for(int length:lengths){int need=length/2;if(pairs<need)break;pairs-=need;++answer;}return answer;} };
